svg.title: Pristine CQD TEM dot projections
svg.desc: A flat qualitative schematic of separated, quasispherical dot-like projections reported for pristine CQDs in Figure 3A. Symbol positions, count, contours, and drawn diameters are illustrative. This is not Figure 3B's protamine-induced aggregate or a measured three-dimensional particle model.
svg.text: TEM 2.1–2.4 nm reported · symbols not to scale
